desc: Kimber’s Rampart is a flat shooting, modernized 1911 that comes fully equipped is an array of performance enhancing features. Its most notable feature is a patent pending compensator on the muzzle. The compensator seriously cuts down on muzzle rise and recoil and has a toolless takedown. Recoil and muzzle rise is reduced even further thanks to a ported channel on the 5-inch match grade barrel. The slide is outfitted with lightening cuts for a faster lockup as well as custom racing style rear serrations. Other features of the Rampart include Raptor serrations on the frame, Black Lok Custom Boggy G-10 grips, and an ambidextrous safety.
